resources.string: Lets an AI you paired see this phone\'s screen and, during a session you can stop at any time, tap and type for you. While it works, the phone shows a banner and a STOP button. Nothing is sent anywhere except to the AI you paired.
Session defect — the driver has no name
Presence must name the specific driver. End this session and pair again so the agent has a name.
You took over — tap to end
When your AI is working, this card shows it live — and the STOP here, on the banner, and in Quick Settings all end it at once.
%1$s is paused — you have the phone
No one is in your phone right now.
%1$s is in your phone right now.
Invisible apps — not in this build
There is no allow-for-this-session. Every gated action asks on its own.
What %1$s\'s provider does with what it sees is outside this app.
Nowhere else — DeskGuest sends nothing to anyone.
%1$d screens seen so far in this session
The presence layer is part of the screens the agent receives — it is never hidden from the agent.
This app can\'t confirm whether anything is controlling this phone.
This screen can\'t be shown to %1$s
Is this %1$s? Check the words — they must match what your AI shows.
Safety words: %1$s — they must match what your AI shows.
Setup takes about 5–8 taps on your own phone. An Android endpoint takes about 10–14 taps, including the steps Android reserves for itself.
Opens the approval gate. Chat cannot approve.
This pairing ended, so this thread is closed.
Give %1$s full control of this phone? From then on it can act on everything you allow here, without asking each time.
Look only — it can see the screen and read phone info, but it cannot tap, type, or change anything.
Presence check passed — the box, the ring, and the glow all drew.
Presence check failed — a session can\'t start until presence can be shown.
Screens could not be counted where they were captured, so no screen count is shown for them.
Always on — no one can change this
Write this key down and keep it somewhere safe. Without it, an encrypted backup cannot be opened — not by this app, and not by anyone else.
